description.value:
You gain an additional arm, tentacle, or similar appendage, usually with the same anatomy as your existing arms, though alternatives are available, such as tails engineered to carry items. Regardless of its appearance, the additional appendage functions identically to your existing arms and hands, or the equivalent for your ancestry. You can hold an additional hand's worth of weapons and equipment but must @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Switch Hands] to wield items with the additional appendage, as normal for characters with more than two hands.

Special If you have a second additional appendage augmentation, you can treat them both as a single pair of hands for the purposes of Switching Hands. If you have a third, it's treated as its own set of hands, though you can treat it as a pair with a fourth additional appendage, and so on. Each additional appendage still applies to your body's implant limit, even if they're paired together.
